note:
Investigation of default tool-result truncation in codely-cli.

After a successful tool call, CoreToolScheduler and nonInteractiveToolExecutor call ToolResultSizeManager.assessToolResultSize. Text tokens are characters divided by 2. sessionTokenLimit defaults to -1, so the session budget is the model limit times 0.7. Regular tools may use max(5000, floor(session * 0.55 * 0.6)), about 33 percent. SubagentToolWrapper gets 90 percent. A calculation failure falls back to 25000 tokens, or 500000 for agents.

When the verdict is text-too-large and canReduceToolSource is true, buildOversizedToolResultOutputs writes the full payload under tool-outputs and returns a tail of at most 16000 characters and 1000 lines. A failed write keeps the full payload.

canReduceToolSource(undefined) is true. With CODELY_COMPACT_EXPERIMENTAL off the source stays undefined, so the tail path is the default. With the flag on, reduction is blocked unless captureStatus is complete_source.

Images and videos use a 5 MB base64 cap and a 20 MB raw cap, and are replaced by a not-sent description.

applyAggregateFunctionResponseBudget no longer enforces the old 200000-character batch bar.

The shell tool truncates earlier, inside formatLargeTextForModel, at DEFAULT_SHELL_OUTPUT_TAIL_LINES of 1000.

Unity maybeCompressUnityToolOutput is a separate client-side fold and is not this shared gate.

Bug: Cowork shows a C# LSP install-failure toast even when the server binary is bundled with the app.

Cause: Hub restore never loads the LSP manager, then the UI looks up codely-unity-lsp-server on PATH and reports it missing.

Fix: load the LSP manager while restoring the newest workspace, and skip the PATH check when the binary is bundled.

Check: open a workspace that vendors the LSP and confirm the install-failure toast does not appear.

cam recall fuses BM25 and vectors with reciprocal rank fusion. The constant k is 60, and the fused score is scaled by k+1 so a document that is first on both lists scores 2.

A separate mechanism forgets. Ebbinghaus stability S starts at 7 days. A successful recall sets S to S * 1.7. needs_update becomes true when retention falls below 0.3.

cam read returns an outline for a file path and the symbol body for a symbol path. The full flag reads the whole file only when the argument is a file path, not a symbol path.

Unrelated policy: memories are never deleted. Replacing one uses cam add --supersedes with the old id. parent only places the memory in the structural tree.
